transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Well, I guess what finally brought me in is that I just don't feel like myself anymore. I used to always make time for things I enjoyed—painting, hiking, my choir, even just the usual Sunday family gatherings. But lately... I don't know, even when I have a free hour to do any of that, I just sit there. I just find myself completely unable to care about any of it.
Did something stressful happen in your life around the time you started feeling this way?

No, not really. I've actually thought about that a lot, trying to figure out what triggered this, but... nothing really stands out. Work at the school is the same as it always is, and things at home are fine. There wasn't any big stressful event or anything like that that I can point to.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Well... I'd say it's been building for about eight months now. Yeah, it started right around the time I took over the STEM-Arts curriculum initiative at the school.
Before these past eight months, had you been feeling down or low most days for at least two years?
No, definitely not. Before these last eight months, I felt pretty normal. I was active, enjoying my hobbies, and doing fine. It really just started recently, not years ago.
Before this started eight months ago, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt depressed or lost interest in things for at least two weeks?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had regular bad days before, just like anyone else, but... never a whole block of time like two weeks where I felt this down. This is really the first time I've ever dealt with something like this.
Over these past eight months, have you been worrying a lot about different things?

No, not really. I mean, I have the normal everyday stress with work and things, but... I wouldn't say I've been worrying a lot about different things. It's not really a feeling of being anxious or worried.
Over these past eight months, have you been feeling down or depressed most days?

Yes, I have. Most days, actually. It's... it's hard to explain, but it feels like there's a heavy gray film over everything. I can be standing right in the middle of a classroom full of students, or just at home with my husband, and I still feel completely hollow... and just close to tears a lot of the time.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of harming yourself?

Yes, I have had some thoughts like that. It's usually late at night... sometimes I'll just be sitting there and I catch myself thinking that it would just be a relief if I didn't wake up the next morning. I haven't actually made a plan to hurt myself or anything like that, but... having those thoughts at all just really scared me. It got to the point where I finally told my husband that I just couldn't keep handling them on my own anymore.
Over these past eight months, have you been having trouble concentrating?

No, not really. I haven't noticed any issues with that. I can still focus on my work at the school and get through the day's tasks just fine. So, no, concentration hasn't really been a problem for me.
Over these past eight months, have you been having trouble sleeping?

Yes, it's been pretty bad. My sleep has been all over the place for months now. I'll just lie awake in bed, um, replaying grant details in my head... and then I usually wake up around three or four in the morning and can't get back to sleep. And even on the nights when I do manage to sleep a bit longer, I still get up feeling like I never rested at all.
Over these past eight months, have you noticed a change in your appetite?
No, not really. I think my appetite has been pretty normal, honestly. I haven't noticed any changes there... I'm still eating about the same amount I always do.
Over these past eight months, have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy?

No, not really. Um, even with the sleep issues I just mentioned, my actual energy levels during the day are fine. I haven't felt unusually tired or anything like that. I still have enough energy to get through my work at the school without a problem.
